title: Creation Day 1: light
note: First day of the creation week, three days before the calendar's first Nisan 1.

title: Creation Day 4: sun, moon and stars — the calendar begins
note: The luminaries are made 'for signs and seasons, days and years'; the DSS calendar counts from this Wednesday.

title: Creation Day 7: the first Sabbath
note: God rests on the seventh day and blesses it.

title: The Flood begins
note: The fountains of the deep break open in Noah's 600th year, second month, seventeenth day — a Sunday at mid-spring on this calendar.

title: The ark rests on the mountains of Ararat
note: Seventh month, seventeenth day.

title: Tops of the mountains are seen
note: Tenth month, first day.

title: Waters dried from the earth; Noah removes the ark's covering
note: First day of the first month of Noah's 601st year.

title: Earth fully dry; Noah leaves the ark
note: Second month, twenty-seventh day.

title: Abraham born
note: Year from the Genesis 11 genealogy; the day is the one given by dsscalendar.org.

title: Covenant with Abraham established
note: 430 years to the day before the Exodus.

title: The first Passover in Egypt
note: The lamb is slain on the fourteenth day of the first month.

title: The Exodus from Egypt
note: Israel leaves Rameses the day after Passover.

title: The Tabernacle is set up
note: First day of the first month of the second year after the Exodus.

title: Israel sets out from Sinai
note: The cloud lifts from the Tabernacle in the second year, second month, twentieth day.

title: Death of Aaron on Mount Hor
note: Fortieth year after the Exodus, fifth month, first day.

title: Moses begins his final addresses (Deuteronomy)
note: Fortieth year, eleventh month, first day.

title: Israel crosses the Jordan
note: Tenth day of the first month; camp at Gilgal.

title: Passover at Gilgal; the manna ends
note: First Passover in the land of Canaan.

title: Solomon's Temple destroyed
note: Day as given by dsscalendar.org; Scripture gives the 7th (2 Kings 25:8) and 10th (Jeremiah 52:12) of the fifth month.

title: The Messiah dies (Passover)
note: Year from DSS 11Q13 as read by dsscalendar.org; on this calendar Passover always falls on a Tuesday.

title: Year 6000 AM begins
note: Close of the 12th Onah and the Age of Grace in this calendar's scheme.

title: First year of the Age of the Kingdom (6001 AM)
note: Start of the 13th Onah in this calendar's scheme.
